pr.title: Name the Projector version in CI reviews, which run Projector from a source tree no package installs
pr.head: 43d81e003e35b409a92fdb7d9e74d0e87dd6dae0

summary: Every Projector review names the Projector version that produced it, in its start comment, in its signature line, and in the hidden marker that later commands read. A reader uses it to tell which release of the review method wrote a verdict, and an incremental review compares it to decide whether it may build on an earlier full review.

Reviews that Projector's GitHub Action posts all named that version unknown. The version came from distribution_version(), which reads installed package metadata, and the action never installs Projector: it runs it straight from a source tree through a small shim that sets PYTHONPATH.

This pull request gives reviews a second source for the version. The action's Set up Projector step reads version from the source tree's .claude-plugin/plugin.json and exports it as PROJECTOR_VERSION to every later step. project review names that variable when it is set and the installed version otherwise. distribution_version() itself is unchanged, because project upgrade and the watch daemon rely on it answering unknown for a source tree.

cards.title: Terms
cards.html:
• Start comment: the comment a review posts when it begins, naming the head, version, model, and effort.
  • Signature line: the first line of a published review, with the same segments plus the verdict.
  • Marker: the HTML comment under the signature, such as projector=0.10.0, that commands parse.
  • Incremental review: a short verdict that builds on an earlier full review, allowed only when the version, model, and effort match.

cards.title: Earlier review findings
cards.html:
• The action's python3 -c now runs with -I, so a repository's top-level json.py can no longer shadow the standard library.
  • docs/cli.md and skills/review-pr/SKILL.md both say a review names PROJECTOR_VERSION when it is set and the version project version reports otherwise.
  • All three finding threads are resolved, and the review of this head is clean.

groups.title: Where a review gets its version
groups.kicker: A new helper that prefers the CI action's stated version
intro: producer_version() returns PROJECTOR_VERSION when it is set and not blank, and falls back to distribution_version(). The three places that name a review's version now call it: the start comment, the signature and marker that heading writes, and the version that incremental_rules compares against an earlier full review's marker.

files.note: Adds producer_version() and switches the three version readers to it.

checks.text: Every other caller of distribution_version(), such as project version, project upgrade, and the daemon handshake in cli.py, still reads the installed distribution. Checked by searching src/ for every caller.

files.note: Updates the distribution_version() docstring to say a review names PROJECTOR_VERSION instead when it is set. The function itself is unchanged.
Says the start comment and signature name PROJECTOR_VERSION when it is set, and the version project version reports otherwise.
Tells the reviewing agent the same thing docs/cli.md says: the version comes from PROJECTOR_VERSION when it is set, and only an uninstalled checkout without it reports unknown.

groups.title: The action states its version
groups.kicker: The setup step exports the source tree's release version
intro: The Set up Projector step already writes the project shim and exports PROJECTOR_ROOT. It now also reads the version from .claude-plugin/plugin.json, which every release keeps equal to pyproject.toml, and exports PROJECTOR_VERSION through $GITHUB_ENV, so the agent's project commands see it.

files.note: Reads the manifest's version and exports it as PROJECTOR_VERSION.

checks.text: The version is read with python3 -I, which keeps the caller's checkout off sys.path, as -P does for the shim. test_the_action_names_its_reviews_by_its_source_trees_version runs the command beside a planted json.py, and it passed in the check job at this head.

files.note: Says the action sets PROJECTOR_VERSION and the review names it.

groups.title: Tests
groups.kicker: One test per side of the change, and a cleared variable
intro: The test package now clears PROJECTOR_VERSION at import, as it already clears CLAUDE_EFFORT. A CI review's gate can run this suite on a runner where the action set the variable, and every review test expects the version the mocked metadata gives.

checks.text: The check job and the repository's review.gate both passed at this head.

files.note: Extracts the action's version-reading command and runs it beside a planted json.py, expecting this checkout's manifest version.
With no installed package and PROJECTOR_VERSION=0.10.0, the start comment, signature, and marker name 0.10.0.
